notes.subject: איים
notes.rationale: 'howlers' (solitary wild creatures) vs KJV 'beasts of the islands' (misreading אי as island)

notes.subject: באלמנותיו
notes.rationale: literally 'his widows', i.e. desolate/emptied houses; rendered 'houses with no one in them'

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: pronoun supplied: Hebrew has only 'her time / her days' without naming Babylon

notes.subject: taim / ol de
notes.rationale: verse fixes Babylon's appointed time as near and her days as not prolonged

translation: Na ol animal i singaut long ol haus i no gat man long en, na ol wail dok long ol bikpela haus bilong gutpela sindaun; na taim bilong ⟨em⟩ i klostu i kamap nau, na ol de bilong ⟨em⟩ bai i no draivim i go longpela.

tokens.gloss: long ol haus i no gat man long en
bai i draivim i go longpela
